item.title: How to get the Biggoron Sword in Ocarina of Time
item.description: Biggoron's Sword is the strongest sword in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. However, it's also the most time-consuming weapon to get in the entire game.

item.title: HBO Max-Paramount Plus Bundle Officially Confirmed for 2027
item.description: HBO Max and Paramount Plus are officially joining forces, with a new streaming bundle set to launch in early 2027. Skydance Corporation, which completed its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery in October, confirmed the plans in its third-quarter shareholder letter on Monday.

item.title: The Best New Video Games of 2026 (So Far)
item.description: It's hard to believe, but 2026 is winding down. Well, maybe that's easy to believe if you remember that Code Vein 2 and Highguard kicked off the year in January, and both now feel like ancient history. We're getting closer to putting together our year-end game of the year come December, but there's still a long road until then. We're still catching up on a busy year of games, from big-budget hits to indie hidden gems. Oh, and there's still this little game called Grand Theft Auto 6 to consider.

item.title: Superman Sequel Will Officially Introduce the DCU’s Wonder Woman, Report Says
item.description: On Monday, James Gunn and Peter Safran stepped down from their leadership roles at DC Studios . Skydance — which recently finalized its acquisition of DC parent company Warner Bros. Discovery — tapped Jeremy Latcham to lead DC . He used to work at Marvel Studios, and coincidentally was a producer on Gunn's Guardians of the Galaxy .

item.title: How to get the Golden Scale in Zelda Ocarina of Time
item.description: The Golden Scale is a unique item in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake that allows Link to dive deeper. You can consider it an upgrade to the Silver Scale, an item that you obtain as young Link as you try to find Princess Ruto . However, unlike the Silver Scale, you can only get the Golden Scale after becoming adult Link .

item.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time’s Coolest Dungeon Hides a Secret Tribute to a Beloved Classic
item.description: Nintendo's highly anticipated remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is finally here, and millions of players are reliving their childhood adventures or experiencing Link's journey for the very first time. Though the Nintendo 64 game has received a dramatic visual glow-up for the Switch 2 , the remake meticulously preserves the spirit of the original — including an extended reference to a classic American novel that even Ocarina diehards may have missed the first time around.

item.title: Mass Effect Legendary Edition Finally Gets Co-op Back on PC
item.description: Mass Effect 3 ’s co-op mode put four players on a map, each with a class and a race, against waves of Cerberus, geth, Reapers, or Collectors. In the original trilogy, it was the only Mass Effect you could play with friends. When Mass Effect Legendary Edition compiled and remastered the games in 2021, that co-op mode didn’t make the cut. Project director Mac Walters said in 2021 that the team’s focus in releasing Legendary Edition was on the single-player experience…and that at some point the team had to draw the line. This year, that changed.

item.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time’s Best Replacement Has 11,000+ ‘Very Positive’ Reviews on Steam
item.description: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake was released last week, nearly three decades after the original came to Nintendo 64. Plenty of newcomers are discovering the greatest game ever for the first time (raises hand) on Nintendo Switch 2 . However, as it’s a Switch 2 exclusive, plenty of gamers might be left feeling like Squidward watching everyone else have fun and frolic in Hyrule.

item.title: Every Legend of Zelda Game, Ranked
item.description: Created by the great Shigeru Miyamoto in the 1980s as an expression of his childhood love of exploring without a map, Zelda has always held a revered position in gaming culture, although it never quite enjoyed popular success to match — not, that is, until its unlikely rebirth in 2017, thanks to the runaway success of the Nintendo Switch and the revolutionary design of Breath of the Wild .
